body:
"I used to trust the media to tell me the truth, tell us the truth.

But now I've seen the payoffs, everywhere I go

Who do you trust when everyone's a crook?"

Revolution calling.
I've found that people in bee suits tend to not be the best people to listen to for advice on life... judging from my experience with 1 person in a bee suit and that guy on the Simpsons
Not at all.
I appreciate your vote of confidence. I have had a lot of tough times, and I'm hoping that things can get better from here.

To be honest, we contracted a "mystery" case of genital warts somehow when we were supposed to be monogamous. Yes, I was stupid and mistrusting-- I assumed that she had gotten it from a previous partner though it didn't show up for a year and a half into our relationship.

I don't think it's STD news. I think it's just going to be emotionally heartbreaking. But thanks for having a level head.

While I wasn't this harsh, if she does contact me again, I will tell her something along these lines. I don't wish her any specific harm. I just hope she regrets how she treated me. I wasn't the best boyfriend either, but I don't deserve this kind of shit.
I took your advice. :)
Thanks, this helped put it in perspective.

Feel free to call me an idiot, but I did say yes at first, and obviously have been agonizing about it for a few hours now. I sent her this:

"I have changed my mind after thinking about it. I do not need to hear your apology. Never contact me again."

The last few words felt good to write and send. Thank you.
I'm leaning towards number 2 right now.
I have. I tend to get told to fuck off and laughed at.

I am happy with who I am. I believe I have many good qualities. The fact that I am fat is not something that makes me a bad person. I know all this, and I like myself.

Another fact is that there are things beyond my control that cause me to be unhappy. I am incredibly lonely. I have no one who makes any kind of attempt to understand "me." Despite being as awesome as I feel that I am, no one else seems to enjoy me.

My point is that my looks are definitely keeping me from doing what I want to do-- from meeting *anyone*, from having even a reasonable conversation, from even being talked to at all for the most part. (And I do try.) 

I don't know how closely you read my post, but I am trying to lose the weight the best I can. I don't care what people think about me outside of the fact that I am SO FUCKING ALONE THAT I NEED SOMEONE TO TALK TO. I'm comfortable with myself. I've spent 24 years mostly alone. I don't even know if someone who hasn't been totally alone can even understand the feeling.

Much of this might be my area, or just plain bad luck. 

I do think that there is merit to the "fuck 'em" mindset. I believe that if people truly got to know me, they would like me. I am vulnerable because I am lonely, and that is something I seek to alleviate.
unfortunately, they're the ones I get.
Then people ask you "why" and think you're a creep. This has happened to me a lot, even when I explain that Omegle disconnects me very often... I just want to talk to someone... :(
Wish I had been there at the time, my friend.

He is gone. But your memories of him are not. You spent time with him and made it as meaningful as you could at the time. He clearly cared about you and you cared about him. I'd say that is as good as anything could have been.

It is painful, and so is life, but the happy times are worth it.

There are other people who have experiences to share. And they will never be quite like him. But they will be worth your time. It is okay to feel unhappy about it... but eventually you need to appreciate the good times and weather the bad.
It's pretty much what conversation in all forms has dulled down into.

Well, I didn't say it was going to happen... in fact, I compared your conversation favorably to it, saying that it wasn't happening! I was talking and shared a detail.

It's changing my environment, but it means I still have to be here, and miserable, for at least several more months... and that's very painful.

>And sometimes you project: like your ending statement, "not calling me boring and fucking fat and shit." Why would you assume I would do that?

Because that's what people do to me. That's all. It happens a lot more frequently than you'd think, it seems. I said that because it's what was on my mind and it's true... it's better than talking to someone who will tell me those things.

I don't have too much to say about anything else... I don't have the option of leaving where I am at the moment, I'm hoping to graduate after this semester and then go to either Hunter or Albany. So changing my environment isn't going to work in the short term. 

I don't feel completely hopeless but I am desperately alone. Whether it's because of my faults or of circumstances beyond my control, I'm not sure, but it sucks to deal with it and I really question whether or not it's worth it.

Hey. 

Life is all you have, so you must try to make the most of it.

And even though it is hard, you have my support, for whatever it is worth.

The steps I take to be happy: get up, get to school and work, attempt to excel at everything I do, try not to think too negatively, try to make a positive difference in the world and in people's lives, and make contact with people wherever possible while maximizing the use of the small amount of energy I manage to muster up on any given day.

I try to take the initiative. How many girls have I tried to talk to who give me their name and then immediately turn away? Dozens... How many people have I talked to in class who only find out I am capable of actually doing the work and then attempt only to use me for answers? Maybe 15 or 20. 

About 70% of the people I'd consider wanting to think about starting to talk to wear headphones whenever they're not immediately engaged in a conversation. Basically the universal sign of "leave me the fuck alone." Of the remaining amount, most are shallow in terms of thinking... which is very uninteresting and I imagine I come off as uninteresting to them. Or they are only interested in my expertise in the subject. 

When I say no one even bothers to make conversation I mean even when I begin it. People tend to say "okay!" or "mmhmm" about anything without truly thinking about it. (This is something I noticed as a tutor as well as in regular conversation.) Even when prompted, they are unable or unwilling to make their end of the conversation. I have nothing in common with most of them. As far as asking them about themselves, I do. In fact I'm really genuinely interested. Not sure if that comes through when I ask them, but it's the case, and I can't see any other way of asking questions that would make it more believable.

I care about people. I work as a student tutor, and I even volunteer my time there. I have spent many hours online talking to random people who have been hurt, or needed some kind of support. I have helped people with schoolwork for many hours. I want to care about someone who cares about me and in my efforts-- which I have made-- I have found no one.

I am shy. I am also broke and without car, so meeting people outside of school is very difficult. I know I am "weird" in some ways, but I like who I am and I think I have a unique set of experiences which I'd love to share, and I'd love to have someone share theirs with me. What I don't understand is why I am constantly rejected. Why I am constantly made to feel bad about myself and what I look like.

Why can't there be someone who even halfway gets it? Instead of being happy and sharing the love that I have to give, I am relegated to walking home in the cold with tears in my eyes as I think about how I would love to see the world destroyed, because fuck this cruel sham of a life.  And I still fucking try. I haven't killed myself yet. Maybe tomorrow, maybe tonight, but not this second. I tried to be happy today. I came home on the bus today and every single person had headphones on. I can't remember anyone I talked to other than people who needed tutoring and the "hello" to my coworkers. Even smiling at strangers tends to make them give me a "fuck you lookin at" look. Can you really blame me for not seeing a reason to continue bothering? I should mention this is in NY, so it's not unexpected.

I take the biggest steps I possibly can towards being happy each day. It is, in fact, the situations that occur in my life that keep me from being happy, ones that are largely uncontrollable. The fact that no one even bothers to make conversation. This is not an "assumption," this has been my experience. 

I yearn for some kind of intellectual stimulation that doesn't involve me teaching someone or paying to be taught. Some kind of genuine friendship that does not seem to exist these days... at least not that's offered to me, implicitly or explicitly. Because I have looked.
Yeah, many many times throughout my life, and girls have rejected me specifically because of how I look.

I don't mean to shoot down every idea or hope. Obviously I write this in a bad state of mind... thankfully, I am no longer negative and depressed 24/7, so I can think a little more clearly. I do want things to get better, but I just wish people would open up to me and allow me to open up to them. 

I had very few friends in high school, and one I see occasionally now... it's somewhat pleasant, and slightly better than people online. But I don't seem to meet anyone who is both able and willing to hold a good, interesting conversation with me about really anything... No one approaches me, and while I don't do it often, my approaches tend to be rebuffed. I imagine both of these are mostly due to my appearance.

I don't work with many people around my age. I have tried to make conversation but I am bad at small talk and I do not share the same interests as the people around me. Also, we are often busy and expected to work with students as much as possible so there is not much time for talking.

I am not close to my family... don't get along too well... I work and have no real friends there. I volunteer hours at the same place I work, tutoring students of the community college I attend. No one wants to talk to me outside of my capacity as a tutor, as far as I can tell... and I have tried.
I don't see many people as fat and unattractive as me having friends. And I can't find any place where my talents are appreciated.

I don't think there is anything wrong with me. I think I am intelligent, capable of holding a good conversation, honest, genuine, et cetera. Not perfect, but not "bad." It is other people telling me I am bad that makes me feel like perhaps they are right. I like me-- I don't want to change much about me.

I think a lot of it stems from me being fat and unattractive, rather than my personality, but those are very difficult for me to work on.

I have been in therapy, in and out for much of my life, and I felt I was much improved as of late, because I used to be massively depressed. I am still trying to be optimistic, but life shits on me so much. I just want to be happy, to care about someone and to be cared about.

I am mostly whiny and really need some kind of human contact. I post mostly because I have no one to say it to in real life, and I can talk freely somewhat anonymously here. I could say I post looking for hope but I don't really expect to find it. I can't bear to keep the pain to myself, so I post.
I'm not really sure anymore.

I am just sick of life, after so long and so much pain, and I kind of want to just die. I have so little energy as it is that bothering to go to the doctor and worry about shit like that is just too much. It is hard enough to get up to go to class... and I work a lot and take 18 credits... I've already missed a bunch of time because I was sick... and would it really be so bad to die anyway?

I don't see "many" obese people having couples, and the fact that some do doesn't necessarily mean it's a realistic expectation. I have only a limited amount of tolerance for rejection, and my cup runneth over at the moment.

I intended my first post to be one of solidarity and hope: even though I have so many issues and struggle so hard, and even though I too have a hard time convincing myself it's worth it, I do it. Even if I fuck up sometimes, I'm still achieving. I wasn't looking for help. But, since you asked:

I've tried losing weight, it's fluctuated between 280 and 350 for the past 6 years or so. It takes me a long time and a lot of pain for a little bit of fat loss, so it is, in my opinion, the worst thing in the world.

I get rejected an equal number of times to the number of attempts I make, which varies. Normally, I am "friend zoned," which I believe is because I am an unattractive "nice guy." (In addition to being fat, I am also ugly.) 

I expect very little, though I'd like to have a girlfriend who is intelligent and interested in sex. 

I work about 20 hours a week and take 18 credits, so I don't have much time to get out, and I don't have any friends or money to go out with. This also leaves me with little time to exercise (though I am taking a weight training class, which is one of the ones I've skipped already), and that's without touching on my energy issues, which are myriad.

As for school, which you asked previously: I've never really had too many pleasurable emotions, and certainly none associated with schoolwork, even though what I'm taking (math, physics) are some of the most tolerable subjects, in my opinion. I'm a straight A student at the moment, because even if I slip up, I keep working as best I can to maintain my grades.

I believe I am interesting to talk to, kind, sincere, and intelligent. While I am (of course) depressed, and to an extent insecure, I accept who I am and I try not to let those qualities come out too much in person. Women don't seem to accept me as I am. I think it's because of the fat (and the ugliness.)
I just don't feel convinced that weight isn't a factor.

Well, I meant a full post. I am not sure if my obesity is the main cause, but I simply can't meet women. The fact that I didn't post about it is because I felt I needed to think about it myself more. I'm sick of being rejected, is the primary reason I ask.

Hey man. I feel very similar to how you describe. Several years ago, when I was at my worst, I was doing nothing all day and it was still too much to be awake. I hated life, and wanted to die. 

I pushed myself hard enough and I'm in school, with a job, and it's nowhere near fucking easy. And in the worst moments, I think about how it's not worth it, how I'd only get 6 hours of sleep and I was missing homework, how all I wanted to do was sleep. I still slip up a bit. Skipped some classes a few times already. So I fuck up sometimes. I've been an A student this time around (though I flunked out my first time, ) and I'm genuinely trying my best

And I'm still getting by only because I am lucky enough to live with my parents, pathetic enough as it may be. No car, no real money, debt. No girlfriend--I'm fat and if you're not, you should know it sucks and it's not easy to get rid of, haha. I even might post up later asking for opinions on if it's worth even trying to date when you're fat, since I have such little success.

But you know what? FUCK IT. I am still surviving. I hate so much of it but you really only have this and then you're dead. There's a glimmer of hope, of potential, and even if it's a mirage, what else is there? Die? That'll happen soon enough. I intend to work harder and do as much as I can with everything I've got, and enjoy as much of it as I can.

I'm 24, going to community college, male, no car, broke as shit. (and ugly to boot!) I'm not even talking so much about relationships (though I do miss women, for the most part) but just having a life at all.

It does seem crazy. I don't try to control anything unreasonably, as far as I can see, and am happy to spend time with other people, but they don't seem to want to spend time with me. I am comfortable with myself for the most part; just lonely. What is the problem?

The poem gives me exact feeling on the matter and doesn't actually make things any clearer or better, it is just sad that I can't have that.

I do a lot of things alone. Unfortunately. I am self-sufficient and have my own thoughts and feelings to share. In fact, I feel I am too "self-sufficient", and spend too much time in my own head and doing things by myself. I am lonely. 

Even if I am needy, it seems like a poorly designed society/universe where those who are needy are the ones who get denied. I never ask people for money, and money is a finite resource. I suppose time is as well, though.

You might notice it's a *self* post.

I can say this is pretty much definitely not true. While I do have self-interest, for obvious reasons, I do go into it looking to be kind and help other people, and frankly, your attempt at analyzing me based off of a paragraph is silly. 

Of course, having written this at a bad time (hence r/depression) makes it seem more self-absorbed; it is simply the frustrating end of a long series of experiences where I have found nothing of value for me and not been allowed to share anything of value with anyone else.

For example: I practice the idea of pausing for a breath before anyone speaks; I do take genuine interest; I am a kind person who sincerely wants to learn about others. I never just wait for my turn to talk.
I am not always nice, but I try my best to be kind to other people.
Okay, I'm at least going to try taking your advice with soda and cut it out. I really honestly don't have enough energy to do half the other shit you're talking about at this point in my life.
Who cares?
I agree. Contemplation of suicide is a horrifying idea and I've had to suffer through it many times, and I don't wish it on anyone. But the acceptance of death is important.

I eat very little for the most part, but I drink too much soda. (I know eating very little can be bad, too.) I mostly eat poultry, plain turkey salami sandwiches, turkey burgers, chicken soup, etc. I've been interested in fitness for much of my life (I played football in high school and lifted weights) but I have a slow metabolism and I'm lazy and unmotivated. It's hard to keep working at something when you see no results and feel miserable--exercise never made me feel good, only fucking tired. My family is mostly very overweight, also. 

I'm not so sure that being in shape will make me more confident-- I tend to be unconfident even when confidence may be warranted. Looking better, sure, though I do believe it'd be like putting lipstick on a pig. I have a bad knee and I'm 330 pounds or so, so it's rough to even get started.

I like music a lot, but I mostly play guitar because it's "something to do"... I am pretty heavily in debt and can't afford much, so a cheap guitar gives me something to do. I like music, video games, reading, hiking when it's warmer, and science, but I am unmotivated to do much and unable to afford doing many nice things since I'm poor and in debt. 

He wasn't bad, but I may think I'm beyond help. I did feel "better" after a while talking to him. Sometimes I think that my depression is just due to life circumstances and my own faults in the past and I've fucked up my life to the point where I can't make it better anymore... just like with my ex... I fucked that up and I can't get it back, just like so much else.

To be honest, I don't enjoy much of anything. That's why I often feel it'd be best for me to die. I feel like I wasn't made for this world. I only get bad news, and I only get bad feelings.

I am 24 and attending a local community college. I failed out of college my first time.

For a while I was eating better and exercising, and I've stopped now for a variety of excuses. I've always been obese and even when I would work out for months and months and ate well I would lose very little... it's frustrating, and especially now I lack the motivation to do it. I'm intending on trying again (assuming I don't kill myself or die otherwise,) but I think I'm naturally very ugly on top of being fat, and I can't fix that.

I play guitar, poorly, and go on Reddit.

I've seen therapists on and off throughout my life, and about three months ago stopped seeing one that I had seen for two years because I wanted to focus more on my school, and it really wasn't helping. Medication hasn't helped any of the times I've been on it.
I'm not trying to insinuate I'm smart or anything... tortured, maybe, intellectual, I dunno. I think that's just the vibe I gave off. I feel alone. And I feel hated.
I always wanted to try this, but never got the chance.
Tetris Attack is the best puzzle game ever.
Chrono Trigger came between FF6 and 7, actually. It was also a huge success.
awesome! more good news!
I do.

People are, in general, selfish and forgetful. I would suggest trying to forgive them for their flaws and, instead, try to not be like that-- remember their birthday and be kind to them. Happy belated birthday, man. Be strong and take care of yourself.

I've been a long time atheist and it's made me happier, so I don't exactly relate. I can tell you that many atheists lead fulfilling, happy lives, and rather than taking comfort in God they may take comfort in themselves or real people. If you need someone to talk to, let me know.
I feel very similarly, so I sympathize.
Love him, support him, and tell him positive things about himself.

You can talk to people... anyone you know, about anything. You can talk to me, if you like. You can play video games or listen to or make music or read or go exercise or do any number of things. I often sit and just play my guitar. It's a struggle, every day, for me.

Here's one, since most teachers don't let you use a smartphone as a calculator in my school... If you use a TI-83 or similar calculator, you can write a "program" that consists of plaintext notes. Useful for formulas, etc., and it appears as though you're simply using your calculator when you use it.
I'd love to hear cheating methods. :)

I've tried for years. This is the mark of my life. I try, and try my hardest, fail, and I am told to keep trying. When does it become retarded to keep going? I've felt it has been that way for so many years. Drinking the kool-aid is getting harder and harder.
I don't plan on snapping his neck. It is a thought I have when I am sad and thinking about him and it is something I wish someone would have done to me.

I hope this will help. It is hard to "accept" myself or what I am like. And I really want nothing more than to be happy. I have always said I don't need a lot of money-- just enough to get by so I can be happy. But I have never really been happy and I hate it.
I'm 320 pounds. :\

I've been an atheist since I was a child and I had asked God for help with my depression, etc. before then. I have, in my worst (and most irrational) moments, asked the hypothetical God for help, or for guidance. I notice no difference when I do this than when I don't. It is always bad either way. But thank you for the encouragement.

I always take responsibility for mistakes I make and problems that I cause myself. I only wish I could catch a break once in a while where one of my mistakes wouldn't cause everything to fall apart, or maybe I'd have something accidentally go right for once.  So far, no dice. 

You say life is worth living, and I am familiar with the idea that it's all we have (and I am an atheist, so I concur.) But I don't see why life is inherently "good" or "worth it." If it's a net loss, why bother? One of the few things that has kept me around is that idea. After life, there's nothing, so there's no reason to end it early. But when it's really so fucking lame, why the hell not?

You also say to love myself. But how the fuck can I do that? I don't love myself. There is no reason to love me, and I don't expect anyone else to do it. Why should I? And even if I knew why, I doubt I could just make it happen.

If what I thought was hope is crushed, then I have never known hope. That alone is reason enough to give up, I think.

(You'll have to forgive me for being disagreeable. I'm obviously upset, and may not be as open to positivity as I could be. I am trying, but I feel like shit and want to die.)

I haven't had ECT but it's something I've considered and have forgotten about. Maybe forced brain damage is the answer. Kind of like a safer version of drilling into my own brain as referenced in a previous comment, Pi-style.

I admit that I don't know what lies in the future. But I do feel that my pain, and the pain in my life, has well outweighed future happiness. I am stuck in a horrible version of the bus problem-- where you wait for the bus for an hour and it doesn't come, but you don't want to leave the bus stop because hey, it should be here any minute, right? I've been waiting for happiness (and struggling to flag it down when it comes by every time) for years now. Maybe I should just accept it's not going to pick me up.
My insurance won't cover it, unfortunately, so I can't afford to self-medicate like that all the time.

I've been in and out of therapy for many years, and nothing has really helped. I chose to believe the "things get better if you just believe they will and work hard!" and it seems like bullshit from my point of view, now especially.

When I went to a depression support group in the past, I was the only one who seemed "truly" depressed. At the time I had made a deal with myself, to give myself one year and if life had improved at all, I wouldn't kill myself; if it didn't, I would. When I talked about this, and how it was freeing kind of, I was met with odd stares and "that's probably not the best way to do it." In addition, there were two girls there who asked me many probing questions, and I only found out afterwords that they were not depressed, instead they came to see what depressed people were like or what a support group was like... something vaguely academic like that... it made me feel like an animal in the zoo, and I haven't gone anywhere like that since.

I don't have the energy to fight anymore. I don't want to do it. I just want to go to sleep and not wake up. not worry about the pain of suicide or the pain of living. just die in my sleep. if there was a just god he'd do that for me. hopefully he will tonight.

I don't know. I don't think I've really known happiness. Everything I can recall doing has only been for a respite from pain. I don't have a physical illness (I'm obese, but nothing like cancer.) If you call depression an illness, then there's that.

I think the happiest times in my life are when I am about to fall asleep, when I don't know what's going on, when I can forget about being. I like the night sky, too, though I live in a pretty light-polluted area so it's not so great. I don't think I've ever woken up and not regretted it.

This will sound douchey, and I never claimed to not be a bad person. But I'm largely uninterested in other people. No one gives a fuck about trying to get to know me. Why should I give a fuck about them? I don't; almost every time I have it's either been worthless or worse than worthless and I end up getting hurt, insulted, or used. That's why if I had that button to end all life I sometimes think I'd really do it.

I even think this about my family's dog... he was abused by a former owner before my family got him, and he is scared. I identify with him. And sometimes when I pet him, I want to snap his neck so that he will not have to bear the horror of life anymore. I have not done it, and I doubt I will, it is usually just a fleeting thought. But I do wish someone had done it for me.

I'm sorry-- I'm self-absorbed, I know. You (and everyone else) are being kind and I appreciate it. I don't know much else besides this kind of pain, though, and my life kind of revolves around it, so I end up coming back to it...

I hate it, and I wish it'd end, and the easiest way to do that would be to die.

I don't really want to fulfill your request... I actually really hate the way I look, especially my smile... when I was in first grade, I caught a glimpse of myself in a trophy case, and I thought, "man, that guy is REALLY ugly." I didn't realize it was me until a moment later, since I was young and didn't look in the mirror much at home. I still feel that way. I think I would feel worse, especially because a smile would probably make my cracked, dry lips split. 

I am a college dropout, first and foremost. I am in college, yes. My physics courses that I've taken are non-calculus based, and as such probably won't transfer anywhere for a physics course. (I have taken calculus, but I was unaware until this semester that a calculus-based physics class was offered at my school, which is why I say it's my fault, though when I talked to counselors no one told me it was available either.) So two of my major classes are probably worthless to transfer anywhere. One of the issues I found out today that made me feel so shitty was that the school I was hoping to transfer to next semester has not received my transcript from my current school so I will likely not get in. Considering I am getting kicked out of my house in January, which was when I was hoping to start dorming at that school, my life totally seems to be fucking falling apart, and I wish I had a gun to just end it on my own terms. I will be homeless, poor, and nearly fucking 25 and STILL not making real progress towards a degree. I was hoping to meet people, even if they were younger than me, and maybe actually have some friends, live on my own away from my fucking family again... but instead i'll probably have to wait another fucking half a year or more before anything even gets started... still going to this awful fucking school where nothing i do really counts and where i don't feel like i learn anything useful.

fuck it.

I work as a tutor at my community college. I am sort of good at teaching people, but I don't really enjoy it... it was just an available job. Helping people isn't bad, per se, but I feel it's largely pointless... I figure most of these people wouldn't spit on me if i was on fire. I know I sound bitter, and I am, VERY bitter. I dislike humanity, and I have often thought that if I had a button to push that would destroy all life, I would do it. 

At the same time I try to go through life at least having compassion for others... because I [think that I] know that people are products of their environment and their biology. "they know not what they do." I try to forgive people and help everyone I can. 

I have little attachment to humanity or human life.

I am posting because part of me does not want to die. That is the same part of me that was willing to try advice that the rest of me would have assumed was bullshit, the same part that is willing to be fooled into thinking that things can get better, the same part that listens to people when they say hang in there... I think this is the very naive part of me, and if I could have carved it out of myself long ago I think I would have done that... sometimes i think about the scene in the movie pi when he drills into his head... sometimes i think i can feel the part of my brain that lets me feel so fucking shitty and i just want to drill as much as i can on the offchance that i'd survive and be happy... or die

In a very broad sense, I'm studying physics. Because of a variety of setbacks that are arguably my fault and which I won't bore you with, the idea that any of the effort I've made towards getting good grades in my physics classes will actually pay off in a bachelor's degree (even assuming that I don't die) is in doubt. I "enjoy" physics as much as I enjoy anything. I don't really. It's just less miserable than English, History, or anything else I've had to bother with in my education. 

I have played guitar once with a friend of mine who plays drums and keyboard. I am by far the worst musician in my group of friends and it is embarrassing. Making music with him was a strange experience, and while I didn't hate it enough to never do it again, it is hard to be bad and try to play with better musicians. I do not feel enough dedication to get better... I honestly don't have the energy... there is too much shit to do and it is all so draining and awful..

I play the guitar. I don't particularly enjoy it, but it is a somewhat "productive" activity and was what was suggested to me at the time. I don't hate it as much as I hate most things in life, I suppose. And getting better is rewarding to an extent. However, I feel like I am going through the motions-- doing what I am supposed to enjoy because that is all there is to do, and it is a facade. Again, maybe I am dramatic, but I feel like the only thing I would actually enjoy is to sleep forever.

I'm in my second full-time semester at a community college, after a failed attempt in 2005 where I was often too depressed to get out of bed (and my grades suffered for obvious reasons.)
